comparison_boundary: Run C is a post-hoc recovery experiment and does not alter the preregistered Day 12 A/B conclusion.

intervention.name: mix_C_finance_reduced
intervention.change_from_mix_A: Finance supervised-token share was halved from 25% to 12.5%; the released share was divided equally across general, math, and code.

continuation_gate.decision: Stop Run C; do not train 60_percent or 100_percent.

interpretation.supported: Halving the finance supervised-token share alone did not recover Base math/general capability under the existing full-parameter, constant-peak-LR SFT recipe.
interpretation.not_supported: This post-hoc pilot does not prove that finance data is harmless or identify one universal failure cause.
interpretation.diagnostic_signal: Code remained above Base by 3 cases, while math fell by 11 and general fell by 2. The dominant failure is still cross-capability retention/format interference rather than insufficient training duration.
interpretation.next_experiment: Do not repeat the same recipe with more tokens. Repair task routing/output formats first, then test a lower or decayed learning rate with an early checkpoint; alternatively establish an instruction-tuned baseline for a performance-first path.

storage.reason: The data disk still has sufficient free space, so A/B/C checkpoints and all reports were retained.

frozen_test.reason: No checkpoint passed the dev promotion gate.
